name: nika
description: Nika — intent-as-code for AI workflows: author a reviewable DAG in YAML, audit cost and permits BEFORE running, keep tamper-evident traces after. Requires the nika binary: brew install supernovae-st/tap/nika

interface.longDescription:
Nika turns repeatable AI work into a file. One .nika.yaml holds the whole job as a reviewable DAG: model calls, shell steps, tool calls and bounded agent loops, with the data edges written down instead of implied.

The file is audited before it runs. `nika check` reads the plan, the cost ceiling, the secret flows, the types and the effect boundary, and every finding teaches its own fix. Nothing is spent to find out that a workflow was wrong.

What the plugin adds to your agent: skills for authoring, debugging, operating and migrating workflows; subagents that write a file, root-cause a failed run from its trace, or port an existing script; slash commands for the audit, the scaffold, the trace and the permits boundary; and a read-only oracle that answers schema, example, template and catalog questions without touching your shell.

Running stays yours. The plugin proposes the command; you type it. Spend is capped at the call that would cross the cap, the effect boundary is declared in the file and reviewable in a diff, and every run leaves a hash-chained trace you can verify afterwards.
defaultPrompt: Turn this repeatable task into a checked Nika workflow.
Validate this .nika.yaml file and repair every finding.
Diagnose this failed Nika run from its trace.
